title: Configured session layer
caption: One compiled configuration is reused across a batch while each file takes the direct OXC path or the TSRX scan and projection path.

nodes.config: Lint and format configuration starts as JSON or JSONC above the per-file source hot path.
nodes.compile: The host discovers, merges, and compiles configuration once instead of rebuilding rules for every file.
nodes.session: A configured lint or format session keeps project-stable rules, options, globs, and ignore matching ready for reuse.
nodes.file1: A TSRX file uses the session while taking its scan, projection, and OXC parse path.
nodes.file2: An ordinary JavaScript or TypeScript file reuses the same session and goes directly to OXC.
nodes.fileN: Later TSRX files reuse the already compiled session and perform only their per-file source work.
